input.title: WELCOME5 promo can be redeemed multiple times by the same user
input.spec_rule: "WELCOME5 — 500 cents off. Each user can redeem it once in total (a later cancellation does not give it back). A second redemption returns 400 code promo_already_used."
input.expected: Second POST /orders by alice with promoCode WELCOME5 returns 400 {"error":{"code":"promo_already_used",...}}.
input.actual: Second (and further) redemption returns 201 with discountCents 500 again. Also seen working after the first WELCOME5 order was cancelled.

input.title: Event pagination overlaps: page N repeats the last item of page N-1 and skips one
input.spec_rule: "Pages are disjoint and contiguous: concatenating pages 1..n yields every event exactly once, in order."
input.expected: page=1&pageSize=5 returns ids 1-5; page=2&pageSize=5 returns ids 6-10.
input.actual: page=2&pageSize=5 returns ids 5-9 (id 5 duplicated). Similarly page=2 with default pageSize 10 returns ids 10-12, duplicating id 10. Offset appears to be (page-1)*pageSize - 1.

input.title: FAN10 discount truncates instead of rounding to nearest cent
input.spec_rule: "FAN10 — 10% off the subtotal, rounded to the nearest cent, halves rounded up."
